name: ChannelEA1
summary: ChannelEA1 is a channel-based breakout EA that trades when price breaks out of a dynamically calculated channel. It enters positions in the direction of the breakout and manages exits through a combination of take-profit and stop-loss levels derived from channel width.
summary_zh: ChannelEA1是一个基于通道突破的EA，当价格突破动态计算的通道时进行交易。它在突破方向入场，并通过由通道宽度推导的止盈和止损水平管理出场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于价格通道的突破交易。通道通过高低价的滚动窗口计算得出，形成上下轨边界。当价格突破上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空，属于典型的通道突破策略。入场条件依赖价格收盘价突破通道边界确认，避免假突破。出场条件包括固定止盈止损和通道反向突破出场两种方式。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面提供了风险百分比参数，但缺少最大回撤控制和仓位上限保护机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is channel breakout trading based on a dynamically calculated price channel. The channel is constructed using a rolling window of high and low prices to form upper and lower boundary bands. It enters long when price breaks above the upper band and short when price breaks below the lower band, following a classic channel breakout paradigm. Entry conditions rely on close price confirmation beyond channel boundaries to filter false breakouts. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels as well as a channel reverse breakout exit mechanism. Position sizing supports both fixed lots and dynamic lot calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management provides a risk percentage parameter but lacks maximum drawdown control and position limit protection mechanisms.

parameters.description: 资金风险百分比，用于动态手数计算
parameters.description_en: Account risk percentage for dynamic lot calculation

parameters.name: MagicNumber

parameters.description: 是否使用动态手数计算

pros: 通道突破策略逻辑清晰，易于理解和验证
提供固定手数和动态手数两种仓位管理模式，灵活性较好
使用收盘价确认突破，减少假突破带来的亏损
通道宽度自适应市场波动，在不同行情下具有一定适应性
pros_en: Channel breakout strategy logic is clear and easy to understand and verify
Provides both fixed lot and dynamic lot sizing modes for good flexibility
Uses close price confirmation for breakouts to reduce losses from false breakouts
Channel width adapts to market volatility, providing some adaptability across different market conditions
cons: 缺乏最大回撤控制和仓位上限保护，极端行情下风险较大
通道突破在震荡行情中容易频繁止损，没有趋势过滤机制
缺少滑点和点差过滤，在流动性差的市场中可能获得较差的成交价
没有多时间周期确认，单一周期突破信号可靠性有限
cons_en: Lacks maximum drawdown control and position limit protection, creating significant risk in extreme markets
Channel breakouts frequently hit stop-loss in ranging markets without a trend filter mechanism
No slippage or spread filter, potentially resulting in poor fill prices in low-liquidity markets
No multi-timeframe confirmation, limiting the reliability of single-timeframe breakout signals
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如大周期均线方向），在震荡行情中抑制交易信号
添加多时间周期确认机制，提高突破信号可靠性并减少假突破亏损
增加最大回撤保护和每日最大亏损限制，提升资金安全
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., higher timeframe moving average direction) to suppress signals in ranging markets
Implement multi-timeframe confirmation to improve breakout signal reliability and reduce false breakout losses
Add maximum drawdown protection and daily loss limits to enhance capital safety

risk_points: 通道突破在震荡市中可能连续触发止损造成累积亏损
缺少最大回撤和每日亏损限制保护机制
无滑点和点差过滤可能在低流动性时段造成额外损失
risk_points_en: Channel breakouts may trigger consecutive stop-losses in ranging markets causing cumulative losses
Lacks maximum drawdown and daily loss limit protection mechanisms
No slippage or spread filter may cause additional losses during low-liquidity sessions

summary_en: ChannelEA1 is a channel-based breakout EA that trades when price breaks out of a dynamically calculated channel. It enters positions in the direction of the breakout and manages exits through a combination of take-profit and stop-loss levels derived from channel width.
